title: Secret Lair Drop Series: A Marvelous Mathoms Superdrop

paragraphs.text: A Marvelous Mathoms Superdrop is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on August 17, 2026.

Adjacent to the release of the The Hobbit set, this is a Universes Beyond cross-over product based on the novel of the same name by J.R.R. Tolkien . It was created in close cooperation with Middle-earth Enterprises , the firm that owns the rights.

" Mathom " is an old Hobbit word that is used to refer to "trinkets" or any item that Hobbits have no particular immediate use for, but are unwilling to throw away. Mathoms are often passed from hand to hand, and Hobbit houses tend to be crowded with mathoms.
For every $149 spent in a single order, you can get a borderless Secret Lair Promo Swan Song with art by Tyler Walpole .
As an extra, the drops come with a surprise bonus card . Each drop has its own unique, fixed bonus card.
